title: Research MAX-STRUCT

references.description: 主仓库，冻结 SHA `7317601b43b914525c21f09e5a60020552ea677b`。[固定版本](https://github.com/migodam/b1-probabilistic-maxwell-imaging/tree/7317601b43b914525c21f09e5a60020552ea677b)。本报告读取指定公式库与关键原始报告，不声称逐行审计整个仓库。
Maxwell Formula Atlas，同一 SHA 下的 [公式库目录](https://github.com/migodam/b1-probabilistic-maxwell-imaging/tree/7317601b43b914525c21f09e5a60020552ea677b/research/maxwell_formula_atlas)。已读取以下文件：

FBG-R3-E [原研究报告](https://github.com/migodam/b1-probabilistic-maxwell-imaging/blob/7317601b43b914525c21f09e5a60020552ea677b/research/research_fbg_r3_experiments/RESEARCH_REPORT_ZH.md)；同目录 `CIE_TSOM_BASELINE_AUDIT.md` 与实际 CIE 实现由动力学分支核对。

FBG-R3-E [数学审计](https://github.com/migodam/b1-probabilistic-maxwell-imaging/blob/7317601b43b914525c21f09e5a60020552ea677b/research/research_fbg_r3_experiments/MATHEMATICAL_AUDIT.md)。CIE–CSI 缺陷差、0/2/4 阶、多源相容性与原物理校正的归属来源。

FBG-R2 [原研究报告](https://github.com/migodam/b1-probabilistic-maxwell-imaging/blob/7317601b43b914525c21f09e5a60020552ea677b/research/research_fbg_r2_adaptive_feedback/RESEARCH_REPORT_ZH.md)。由独立动力学分支核对；本报告不将其与 R3-E 批次混合。

Z-ALG R4-BASIN [原研究报告](https://github.com/migodam/b1-probabilistic-maxwell-imaging/blob/7317601b43b914525c21f09e5a60020552ea677b/research/research_z_alg_r4_basin/RESEARCH_REPORT_ZH.md)。局部下降与 GT 恢复分离、非局部候选失败的主要证据。
A17 [冻结仓库版本](https://github.com/migodam/a17-maxwell-certified-exchange/tree/2ac81b989a2f13d62df9d5a7abd690a33c2189c7)。
A17 closure [START_HERE](https://github.com/migodam/a17-maxwell-certified-exchange/blob/2ac81b989a2f13d62df9d5a7abd690a33c2189c7/closure_final/START_HERE.md)。
A17 [三维追加实验报告](https://github.com/migodam/a17-maxwell-certified-exchange/blob/2ac81b989a2f13d62df9d5a7abd690a33c2189c7/additional_3d_examples_20261030/RESEARCH_REPORT_ZH.md)。

Budko, N. V.; Samokhin, A. B. *Spectrum of the volume integral operator of electromagnetic scattering*. SIAM J. Scientific Computing 28, 682–700 (2006). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1137/050630660)；[作者预印本](https://arxiv.org/abs/math-ph/0505013)。三维 dyadic VIE 本质谱；不以 scalar 紧核直觉替代。

Zouros, G. P.; Budko, N. V. *Transverse Electric Scattering on Inhomogeneous Objects: Spectrum of Integral Operator and Preconditioning*. SIAM J. Scientific Computing 34, B226–B246 (2012). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1137/110831568)。保持 FFT 的乘法正则化是已有方法。

Markkanen, J. *Numerical Analysis of the Potential Formulation of the Volume Integral Equation for Electromagnetic Scattering*. Radio Science 52, 1301–1311 (2017). [原文](https://agupubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/2017RS006384)。势的连续性、离散空间及界面电荷处理是 M1 必须面对的先例。
Anderson, W. N., Jr.; Trapp, G. E. *Shorted Operators. II*. SIAM J. Applied Mathematics 28, 60–71 (1975). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1137/0128007)。shorted operator 的经典来源；正文有限公式给出独立证明，不声称其首次性。

Borcea, L.; Liu, J.; Zimmerling, J. *Electromagnetic inverse wave scattering in anisotropic media via reduced order modeling*. J. Computational Physics 515, 113272 (2024). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jcp.2024.113272)；[完整预印本](https://arxiv.org/html/2403.03844v1)。正文模型为二维矢量、沿一方向不变，不是已完成任意三维。

Borcea, L.; Druskin, V.; Zimmerling, J. *A Reduced Order Model Approach to Inverse Scattering in Lossy Layered Media*. J. Scientific Computing 89, 1 (2021). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10915-021-01616-7)；[作者论文](https://public.websites.umich.edu/~borcea/Publications/ROM_LOSSY.pdf)。有损层状 ROM 已有，局域实现性与被动性不应简单混同。

Albicker, A.; Griesmaier, R. *Monotonicity in inverse scattering for Maxwell's equations*. Inverse Problems and Imaging 17, 68–105 (2023). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.3934/ipi.2022032)；[作者完整论文](https://ianm.math.kit.edu/downloads/rg-ip/griesmaier/monotonicitymaxwell.pdf)。第 6 节的支撑资格与探测算子已核对。

Harrach, B.; Pohjola, V.; Salo, M. *Dimension bounds in monotonicity methods for the Helmholtz equation*. SIAM J. Mathematical Analysis 51, 2995–3019 (2019). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1137/19M1240708)；[预印本](https://arxiv.org/abs/1901.08495)。有界域标量结论，不直接代替 Maxwell 例外计数。

Arens, T.; Griesmaier, R.; Zhang, R. *Monotonicity-based shape reconstruction for an inverse scattering problem in a waveguide*. Inverse Problems 39, 075009 (2023). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1088/1361-6420/acd4e0)；[作者机构库](https://publikationen.bibliothek.kit.edu/1000160558)。有限传播通道与例外维数增长的关键邻近反例。

Griesmaier, R.; Harrach, B.; Xiang, J. *Monotonicity-based regularization of inverse medium scattering for shape reconstruction* (2026). [预印本](https://arxiv.org/html/2602.02052v1)；[期刊 DOI](https://doi.org/10.1137/26M1854318)。本轮以完整预印本为理论依据；研究对象是全角度标量 Helmholtz。

Guo, C.; Bal, G. *Reconstruction of complex-valued tensors in the Maxwell system from knowledge of internal magnetic fields*. Inverse Problems and Imaging 8, 1033–1051 (2014). [DOI/原文入口](https://www.aimsciences.org/article/doi/10.3934/ipi.2014.8.1033)；[预印本](https://arxiv.org/abs/1308.5872)。内部场、局部电场基和额外秩条件，不能解释成少数外部源的一般唯一性。

Benner, P.; Gugercin, S.; Werner, S. W. R. *Structure-Preserving Interpolation for Model Reduction of Parametric Bilinear Systems*. Automatica 132, 109799 (2021). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.automatica.2021.109799)；[预印本](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.11269)。共同闭包方向的系统理论先例。

Griesmaier, R.; Hanke, M. *One-shot inverse scattering revisited*. SIAM J. Imaging Sciences 18, 881–905 (2025). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1137/24M1709753)；[作者论文](https://ianm.math.kit.edu/downloads/rg-ip/griesmaier/oneshotrevisited.pdf)。分离源/散射体定位的低阶 Fourier 与有理逼近先例。

Guo, L.; Nguyen-Trong, N.; Nguyen, P.; Bialkowski, K.; Abbosh, A. *Microwave Tomography Using Random Multiple-Input–Multiple-Output Contrast Source Inversion*. IEEE AWPL 20, 1369–1373 (2021). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/LAWP.2021.3079905)；[作者机构书目](https://about.uq.edu.au/experts-publication/1006/4748)。本轮核对先例存在及书目，未据未取得的全文判断其矩阵是否酉或是否完整运输 covariance。

Bevacqua, M. T.; Palmeri, R.; Isernia, T.; Crocco, L. *A Simple Procedure to Design Virtual Experiments for Microwave Inverse Scattering*. IEEE TAP 69, 8652–8663 (2021). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAP.2021.3083747)；[作者机构摘要](https://iris.cnr.it/handle/20.500.14243/445596)。数据线性重组与 contrast-source 设计已有直接先例。

Trefethen, L. N. et al. *Hydrodynamic Stability Without Eigenvalues*. Science 261, 578–584 (1993). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.261.5121.578)；[作者论文](https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/trefethen/publication/PDF/1993_57.pdf)。借用非正规线性代数工具，不把流体物理定理移植到 Maxwell。
van den Berg, P. M.; Kleinman, R. E. *A contrast source inversion method*. Inverse Problems 13, 1607–1620 (1997). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1088/0266-5611/13/6/013)。

van Leeuwen, T.; Herrmann, F. J. *Mitigating local minima in full-waveform inversion by expanding the search space*. Geophysical J. International 195, 661–667 (2013). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1093/gji/ggt258)。WRI/有限罚场释放先例，不直接提供本问题的全局保证。

Leijsen, R. L. et al. *3-D Contrast Source Inversion-Electrical Properties Tomography*. IEEE TMI 37, 2080–2089 (2018). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2018.2816125)；[作者机构版本](https://pure.tudelft.nl/ws/portalfiles/portal/50622273/45203789_3D_CSI_EPT_Clean_Copy.pdf)。磁场观测与三维 CSI 的直接先例。

Brown, K. G. et al. *Hybridizable Discontinuous Galerkin Method Contrast Source Inversion of 2-D and 3-D Dielectric and Magnetic Targets*. IEEE TMTT 67, 1766–1777 (2019). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/TMTT.2019.2905214)。本轮仅核对身份/摘要，具体算法需执行阶段取得原文后比较，不以未读细节作新颖性结论。

Zhong, Y.; Xu, K. *Contraction Integral Equation for Three-Dimensional Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering Problems*. Journal of Imaging 5, 27 (2019). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.3390/jimaging5020027)；[出版社](https://www.mdpi.com/2313-433X/5/2/27)。原作已有三维矢量、FFT-TSOM 与不同 current/material 反馈参数；部分全文接口限流，本报告的实现细节同时依据仓库原始 audit 和源码。

Novikov, R. G. *The d-bar approach to approximate inverse scattering at fixed energy in three dimensions*. International Mathematics Research Papers 2005(6), 287–349. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1155/IMRP.2005.287)；[预印本](https://arxiv.org/abs/math-ph/0505033)。标量势的特殊非线性散射变换，不是一般有限测量 Maxwell 的一次 IFFT。

Levinson, H. W.; Markel, V. A. *Solution of the nonlinear inverse scattering problem by T-matrix completion. I. Theory*. Physical Review E 94, 043317 (2016). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevE.94.043317)；[预印本](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.3319)。响应线性兼容与材料局域性相交已有，不能重新命名为新变量机制。

Zhong, Y.; Chen, X. *An FFT Twofold Subspace-Based Optimization Method for Solving Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering Problems*. IEEE TAP 59, 914–927 (2011). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAP.2010.2103027)。由原 CIE 参考表核对；普通 twofold/FFT 投影不是新发现。

*Wavelet-Based Subspace Regularization for Solving Highly Nonlinear Inverse Scattering Problems with Contraction Integral Equation*. Electronics 9, 1760 (2020). [原文](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/9/11/1760)。wavelet current 正则已有。

*A Multiresolution Contraction Integral Equation Method for Solving Highly Nonlinear Inverse Scattering Problems*. IEEE TMTT 68, 1234–1247 (2020). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/TMTT.2019.2956939)；[作者机构库](https://iris.unitn.it/handle/11572/260153)。多分辨率 CIE 已有。

Z-ALG-E1 [非对称 Maxwell 材料图册、条件积分与成本反证](https://github.com/migodam/b1-probabilistic-maxwell-imaging/blob/7317601b43b914525c21f09e5a60020552ea677b/research/research_z_alg_asymmetric_validation/RESEARCH_REPORT_ZH.md)。真实有限 Hankel–Green 欠定模型中的非置换局部二维材料图册；成本比较与证书层级均需保留。

new_numerical_evidence: Only dynamics_toy.py: four-material algebraic reciprocal finite VIE; not a physical imaging benchmark.
